front_content.text:
阅读句子，判断下列说法是否正确：

Not until scientists understood the genetic basis of the disease did effective treatments become available.

说法：主句的主语是 scientists，谓语是 understood。

back_content.text: False。scientists understood 属于until从句；主句说 effective treatments became available。
back_content.explanation: Not until ...放在句首，主句的did提前到effective treatments之前。恢复正常语序是 Effective treatments did not become available until scientists understood ...。主句主语是treatments，谓语是did not become。

analysis_content.text: Not until ...放在句首，主句的did提前到effective treatments之前。恢复正常语序是 Effective treatments did not become available until scientists understood ...。主句主语是treatments，谓语是did not become。
tips: 先把Not until引出的整段时间条件括起来，再找主句的助动词与主语。
